changelog: Version 7.0: unified 7.0 version labels across PWA, Android WebView and APK; shop logo picker now opens reliably and saves a compressed image; compact calculator now records each calculation in a left-side history; retained Bluetooth status/device handling, fingerprint sign-in feedback and in-app update flow. Native Android changes are included in the 7.0 APK; PWA and Android HTML update metadata are synchronized.
